fusions.name: Kick at Journey's End
fusions.desc: A kick that deals 26 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Blistered Stomp
fusions.desc: Stamps down, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterwards. Also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 25% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Calloused Stride
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground on foot, you regain 10 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
